after:
Refund processing is asynchronous. A `REFUND` webhook reports validation success or failure; `success: true` means Adyen sent the request onward but does not guarantee final completion. A later `REFUND_FAILED` event can report payment-method rejection, while the online refund guide describes `REFUNDED_REVERSED` as meaning funds from a previously refunded payment returned to Adyen and the merchant account.

> [!warning] Contradiction
> The captured [[source-adyen-api-explorer-webhooks-latest-post-refunded-reversed|REFUNDED_REVERSED API Explorer reference]] says the refunded amount was returned to “your bank account” (its raw line 7). The captured [[source-adyen-docs-online-payments-refund|online refund guide]] instead describes return to Adyen and the merchant account. These destination statements remain source-qualified and unresolved; the event or receiver acknowledgement alone is not independent bank-credit proof.
